name: mhlavac-marketplace
description: Reusable Claude Code plugins — primitives for collaborating with Claude on rich artifacts and multi-turn iteration loops.

plugins.name: annotated-feedback
plugins.description: Ship any HTML artifact wired to receive structured user feedback — inline form elements (textareas / radios / checkboxes / action buttons) keyed by stable IDs, plus a freeform annotation overlay (text highlights, diagram pins, sketches, general comments). One Submit produces a paste-ready Markdown prompt for the next Claude turn. Mermaid diagrams supported out of the box.
